assessment: The deck is a solid bracket-2 Sliver tribal build with good tutors and mana fixing but is thin on card draw and spot removal, and the sacrifice/encore engine around Sliver Gravemother is underfed with only a few sac outlets and no way to reliably mill or discard Slivers into the graveyard. This changeset adds cheap interaction and card advantage while leaning further into the graveyard/encore payoff that defines the commander.

changes.reason: A card-advantage wheel that also refills your hand is better for this deck than a symmetrical discard-draw that dumps your own Slivers without recursion value, and the deck already lacks enough proactive draw.
Sliver Gravemother wants Slivers in the graveyard to encore, and this gives a free sac outlet plus card draw instead of a looting ability that only sometimes finds a target.

cheaper.name: Altar's Reap
cheaper.reason: Same instant-speed sac-for-card effect at common rarity, very cheap.

changes.reason: The deck has only 4 spot removal effects which is thin, and this flexible wipe can also act as a lighter sweeper that fills your own graveyard with Slivers for later encore value.

cheaper.name: Languish
cheaper.reason: Cheaper sweeper that similarly feeds the graveyard with your Slivers.

changes.reason: With only 4 spot removal spells this deck struggles to answer problem permanents, and Vindicate hits any permanent type to cover artifacts, enchantments, and lands that the current list can't touch.
This directly amplifies the sacrifice/death-trigger plan the deck is built around, punishing opponents every time a Sliver is sacrificed to feed the graveyard for encore.
A cheap tutor that can also find Slivers or utility lands supports the graveyard plan better than a bounce-for-life effect that works against filling the graveyard.
This gives recurring graveyard value for the many Slivers that will die, letting you rebuy creatures instead of relying solely on the one-shot encore ability.
The deck is thin on card draw at 8/10 and this provides a recurring, hard-to-remove draw engine across a token-heavy board full of small Sliver attackers.
